lines.en: label library20:
scene onlychildredux1
: Oh, Sensei! Good timing.
lines.zh: : 啊，老师！来得真巧。

lines.en: : Good timing for what? What's going on?
lines.zh: : 巧什么？怎么了？

lines.en: : I was actually just about to leave, so I’m happy you showed up when you did.
lines.zh: : 其实我正准备走呢，所以很高兴你刚好这时候来了。

lines.en: : Futaba, I am not going to watch the library for you. Especially because I don't even think you get paid for this.
lines.zh: : Futaba，我可不会替你看着图书馆。尤其是我觉得你干这个连工钱都拿不到。

lines.en: : I don't. But I'm not going to ask you to do that either since I actually {i}don’t{/i} have to volunteer at all today. I just completely forgot and showed up anyway.
lines.zh: : 是拿不到。不过我也{i}不会{/i}要你那么做，因为今天我其实根本不用来做志愿者。只是我完全给忘了，还是跑来了。

lines.en: : Well, I'm glad you did. Because if I showed up here and you weren't around, I have no idea what I would even do.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很高兴你来了。因为要是我来了而你不在，我真不知道该怎么办。

lines.en: : You could always read?
lines.zh: : 你总可以看看书吧？

lines.en: : Pass.
lines.zh: : 免了。

lines.en: scene onlychildredux2
: Regardless...the library is going to be closed for cleaning today, so you wouldn't be able to read even if you wanted to.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说……今天图书馆要闭馆打扫，所以就算你想看也看不了。

lines.en: : Uh-oh. What are you going to do if you can't spend your morning surrounded by books?
lines.zh: : 哎呀。要是一上午都不能泡在书堆里，你打算怎么办？

lines.en: scene onlychildredux3
: Well...I was kind of hoping...that's where you'd come in.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我其实在想……这就要看你了。

lines.en: : You know...since you {i}also{/i} don’t have anything to do...
lines.zh: : 你看……反正你{i}也{/i}没什么事要做……

lines.en: : Sounds good. I’ll hang out with you.
lines.zh: : 听起来不错。那我陪你。

lines.en: scene onlychildredux4
: You will?! Outside of the library?!
lines.zh: : 真的吗？！在图书馆外面？！

lines.en: : Sure. I mean, like you said, what else do I have going on?
lines.zh: : 当然。就像你说的，我还能有什么事？

lines.en: : Besides, it might be good for the two of us to get out instead of just hanging around here all the time. And that's doubly true for today since it's actually not extremely hot out.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我们俩偶尔出去走走，而不是总在这儿待着，也许是件好事。今天更是如此，因为天气其实不算特别热。

lines.en: scene onlychildredux5
: The weather has been rather unkind lately, hasn't it?
lines.zh: : 最近天气一直都不太友好呢，是吧？

lines.en: : So, what should we do with our new-found free time? Want to go get lunch or something?
lines.zh: : 那么，我们该怎么打发这突如其来的自由时间？想去吃个午饭什么的吗？

lines.en: : I would love to...If that’s okay with you, of course.
lines.zh: : 我很想去……当然，如果你不介意的话。

lines.en: : I can't imagine it would be a...very good look for you being out at some restaurant with someone so much younger...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……你跟一个年纪小你这么多的人一起出现在餐厅里，观感大概不会太好……

lines.en: : Not to mention that some of the other girls from our class could be around here right now...
lines.zh: : 更别说现在我们班的其他女孩说不定就在附近……

lines.en: : I don’t really mind. If we run into someone from class, we can always just tell them I’m helping you study or something.
lines.zh: : 我倒不太在意。要是碰到班上的人，我们大可以说我在帮你补习之类的。

lines.en: : And if that doesn't work, I'll probably just wind up having to spend some alone time with whoever catches us. So it's really not a big deal.
lines.zh: : 万一这招不管用，我大概就得跟逮到我们的那个人单独待上一会儿了。所以真没什么大不了的。

lines.en: scene onlychildredux6
: Heheh...I suppose...that’s one way to handle that situation...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……我想……这也算是一种处理方式吧……

lines.en: : Hey, if you're jealous about me hanging out with the other girls, just try a little harder to not get us caught today.
lines.zh: : 嘿，要是你吃醋我跟别的女孩混在一起，那今天就更努力点，别让我们被抓到。

lines.en: scene onlychildredux7
: I don't...really think that's in my hands, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我……真不觉得那由得了我，老师。

lines.en: scene black
: Well, there's only one way to find out. Come on, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那就只有一种办法能知道了。走了，Futaba。

lines.en: : Wait! Sensei! I still have to pack up my things!
lines.zh: : 等等！老师！我还得收拾东西呢！

lines.en: Futaba and I leave the library and begin to head down the same road I normally take home.
lines.zh: 我和 Futaba 离开图书馆，走上我平时回家的那条路。

lines.en: There are plenty of couples out and about today, but no one that we recognize.
lines.zh: 今天外面有不少情侣，但没有我们认识的人。

lines.en: Well, at least not yet.
lines.zh: 至少目前还没有。

lines.en: After a while, we come to a stop in front of a small restaurant that Ami and Maya eat at often and decide that this is a suitable place to settle down for the time being...
lines.zh: 走了一会儿，我们在 Ami 和 Maya 常去的一家小餐馆前停下，决定暂时就在这里落脚……

lines.en: scene futabaday1
: Umm...thanks for hanging out with me today, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 呃……谢谢你今天陪我，老师。

lines.en: : I know you probably have lots of other stuff to do and-
lines.zh: : 我知道你大概还有很多别的事要做，而且——

lines.en: : I'm going to stop you right there, Futaba. I don't want you making it sound like I’m only doing this for you.
lines.zh: : 我得在这里打断你，Futaba。我不想让你把这说成我只是为了你才这么做。

lines.en: : But...I'm-
lines.zh: : 可是……我是——

lines.en: : You know, one of these days, you’re going to have to accept that I might just enjoy your company.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，总有一天你得接受一个事实：我说不定就是喜欢跟你待在一起。

lines.en: scene futabaday2
: Yeah...uhh...that might be a little harder than you think.
lines.zh: : 嗯……呃……这可能比你想象的难一点。

lines.en: : A girl like me...hanging out with someone as cool and...awesome as you? It just...doesn’t really make sense.
lines.zh: : 像我这样的女孩……和你这么酷、这么……了不起的人待在一起？这怎么想都……说不通。

lines.en: : You've noticed how people have been looking at us, haven't you? It’s like they know...
lines.zh: : 你注意到别人看我们的眼神了吧？就像他们知道似的……

lines.en: : Yeah, I think there might be other reasons why people have been looking at us strangely.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我觉得别人用那种奇怪的眼神看我们，可能还有别的原因。

lines.en: scene futabaday3
: What...exactly do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 你……具体是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that even if you don't look as young as someone like Ami or Sana, I'm still noticeably older than you.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，就算你看起来不像 Ami 或 Sana 那么小，我还是明显比你大。

lines.en: : I could probably even be your father.
lines.zh: : 我说不定都能当你父亲了。

lines.en: scene futabaday1
: Don’t be silly, Sensei. My father is way older than you are.
lines.zh: : 别傻了，老师。我父亲可比你老多了。

lines.en: : If anything, you'd be more like...my older brother.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，你更像……我的哥哥。

lines.en: scene futabaday3
: If...you can get past the part where we don't look anything alike.
lines.zh: : 如果……你能忽略我们长得一点也不像这件事的话。

lines.en: Come to think of it, I don’t really know anything about Futaba’s family.
lines.zh: 说起来，我对 Futaba 的家庭真的一无所知。

lines.en: In fact, I barely know anything about Futaba apart from her affinity for both books and me.
lines.zh: 事实上，除了她喜欢书、也喜欢我之外，我对她几乎一无所知。

lines.en: That said...wouldn't this be a good opportunity to maybe learn about some of that?
lines.zh: 话虽这么说……这难道不是个了解一下的好机会吗？

lines.en: It's clear that the two of us are getting closer, but there's a limit to how close we can get without me going out of my way to learn more about her.
lines.zh: 我们俩显然在越走越近，但如果我不特意去多了解她，我们能亲近到什么程度是有限度的。

lines.en: And I know wording it like that might make it seem like I don't {i}want{/i} to know anything about her, but that's not true.
lines.zh: 我知道这么说可能显得我并不{i}想{/i}了解她，但事实并非如此。

lines.en: I just think it would be a lot easier {i}not{/i} to.
lines.zh: 我只是觉得，{i}不{/i}去了解会轻松很多。

lines.en: : So...on the topic of family...why don't you tell me about yours?
lines.zh: : 那么……说到家庭……不如跟我讲讲你的家人？

lines.en: : I don't really know anything about them.
lines.zh: : 我对他们真的一无所知。

lines.en: scene futabaday4
: My family? Is that...something you're actually interested in hearing about?
lines.zh: : 我的家人？那……你真的想听吗？

lines.en: : Sure. I mean...they're a part of your life, aren't they? You can't just keep me in the dark about your backstory forever.
lines.zh: : 当然。我是说……他们是你人生的一部分，不是吗？你不能永远把你的身世瞒着我。

lines.en: scene futabaday4r
: Heheh...no, I suppose I can't. I can't guarantee you'll be entertained, though, as I don't think we're all that abnormal.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……是，我想是不能。不过我可不敢保证你会觉得有趣，因为我觉得我们家没什么不正常的。

lines.en: : Is there anything in particular you want to know?
lines.zh: : 你有什么特别想知道的吗？

lines.en: : How about...your parents? What do they do? Do they live around here?
lines.zh: : 那就……你父母吧？他们是做什么的？住在这附近吗？

lines.en: : They did. They live overseas now, so I haven't seen them since before Kumon-mi was closed off.
lines.zh: : 以前是。他们现在住在国外，所以自从 Kumon-mi 被封锁前那一别，我就再没见过他们。

lines.en: : Well, in person. I still video chat with them every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 我是说，没见过面。我还是会偶尔跟他们视频通话。

lines.en: scene futabaday2
: It’s a little sad that they're so far away...but I’m independent enough to function on my own, so it’s not like I {i}have{/i} to see them or anything.
lines.zh: : 他们离得这么远是有点难过……不过我足够独立，自己也能过得下去，所以也不是{i}非见{/i}他们不可。

lines.en: : How far overseas are they, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体是在多远的国外？

lines.en: scene futabaday4r
: America. My father is an architect and is working on a bunch of aquariums for some company over there.
lines.zh: : 美国。我父亲是建筑师，正在给那边的一家公司做一批水族馆项目。

lines.en: : And of course my mother followed him since the two of them are pretty much inseparable.
lines.zh: : 我母亲当然也跟着去了，因为他们俩基本上形影不离。

lines.en: It’s good to see that there’s at least one fully functioning family still out there. I was beginning to think that all of my students were from broken homes.
lines.zh: 看到世上至少还有一个完整健全的家庭，感觉真不错。我都开始以为我的学生全都来自破碎家庭了。

lines.en: : Do you look more like your father or your mother?
lines.zh: : 你长得更像父亲还是母亲？

lines.en: : My mom. She’s like a prettier, skinnier, taller version of me.
lines.zh: : 我妈妈。她就像是一个更漂亮、更瘦、更高的我。

lines.en: : Prettier than you? I find that hard to believe.
lines.zh: : 比你更漂亮？这我可不信。

lines.en: scene futabaday5
: Sensei, stop! That’s way too embarrassing and...definitely not true.
lines.zh: : 老师，别说了！这太让人难为情了，而且……绝对不是真的。

lines.en: : Sorry, I couldn’t help it. I made a promise to myself many years ago that I would capitalize on every single chance I have to flirt with attractive girls.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我忍不住。很多年前我就对自己发过誓，要抓住每一个跟漂亮女孩调情的机会。

lines.en: scene futabaday6
: I guess that explains why you're so good at it...It must be all the experience.
lines.zh: : 难怪你这么擅长这个……一定是经验使然。

lines.en: : It definitely comes in handy during times like this.
lines.zh: : 在这种时候确实派得上用场。

lines.en: : So, what about siblings? Do you have any?
lines.zh: : 那么，兄弟姐妹呢？你有吗？

lines.en: scene futabaday4r
: I don’t. I’m an only child.
lines.zh: : 没有。我是独生女。

lines.en: : My mom wanted to have at least one more, but she and my dad decided it wouldn't be a good idea since the two of them travel so much.
lines.zh: : 我妈妈本来想再要一个，但她和我爸爸觉得不太合适，因为他们俩总是到处跑。

lines.en: : It's fine, though. I would have liked having a sibling, but I lucked out and wound up with Rin instead.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。我本来是想要个兄弟姐妹的，但我运气好，最后得到了 Rin。

lines.en: : She might not look like me, but she's better than any other sister I could have possibly asked for.
lines.zh: : 她也许长得不像我，但她比我可能奢求到的任何姐妹都要好。

lines.en: : Well, she definitely seems like she can be a handful at times...so I guess that having her is more than enough to fulfill your sibling quota.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她有时候确实挺让人头疼的……所以我想，有她一个大概就足够填满你的兄弟姐妹配额了。

lines.en: scene futabaday2
: Hahah...I suppose so...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……大概是吧……

lines.en: : I...wouldn’t mind having a big brother as well, though. I’ve kind of always thought it would be nice to have a person like that.
lines.zh: : 不过……我也想要个哥哥。我一直觉得，有那样一个人在身边挺好的。

lines.en: : Any reason why?
lines.zh: : 有什么特别的理由吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know...I just think it would be nice to have someone who would always look after me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我只是觉得，能有个人一直照顾我会很好。

lines.en: : Unfortunately...I don't think I'll-
lines.zh: : 可惜……我觉得我不会——

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Futaba. I’ll look after you.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Futaba。我会照顾你的。

lines.en: scene futabaday6
: Heheh...You promise, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……你保证吗，老师？

lines.en: : Because I won't let you take something like that back, you know.
lines.zh: : 因为你知道的，我说什么也不会让你把这话收回去。

lines.en: : Fine by me. I can't imagine wanting to go back on that.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。我想不出有什么理由要反悔。

lines.en: : Is it okay if I call you big brother then?
lines.zh: : 那我可以叫你哥哥吗？

lines.en: : Of course it is. In fact, please start calling me that right now.
lines.zh: : 当然可以。事实上，请现在就开始这么叫我。

lines.en: scene futabaday7
: W-Wait a second! I was only kidding!
lines.zh: : 等、等一下！我只是开玩笑的！

lines.en: : There’s no way I can just...start calling you that right now! It’s way too embarrassing!
lines.zh: : 我怎么可能就这么……现在开始这么叫你！太难为情了！

lines.en: : Too late. You’ve already brought it up and it's something I absolutely need to hear now.
lines.zh: : 太迟了。这话是你自己提出来的，现在我是非听不可了。

lines.en: : It's also something I absolutely can't do!
lines.zh: : 这也是我绝对做不到的！

lines.en: : How come you can call Rin your sister but not me your brother?
lines.zh: : 为什么你能把 Rin 叫作姐姐，却不能叫我哥哥？

lines.en: : Because I don't have a c-
lines.zh: : 因为我没有——

lines.en: scene futabaday8
: Cat! I don't have a cat! I definitely wasn't going to say {i}crush!{/i} Nope!
lines.zh: : 猫！我没有猫！我绝对不是要说{i}暗恋{/i}！才不是呢！

lines.en: scene futabaday9
: A-Anyway! What else do you want to know about my family?! I'll tell you anything you want!
lines.zh: : 总、总之！你还想知道我家的什么事？！你想知道什么我都告诉你！

lines.en: : You don't have to make it sound like I'm shaking you down, you know?
lines.zh: : 你不用把这事说得好像我在敲诈你似的。

lines.en: scene black
Futaba and I spend the next hour or so discussing her parents while finishing our meals.
lines.zh: 接下来大约一个小时里，我和 Futaba 一边把饭吃完，一边聊着她的父母。

lines.en: As it turns out, she barely even remembers the last time she saw them before they left.
lines.zh: 结果发现，她几乎记不清他们离开前最后一次见面是什么时候了。

lines.en: She mentions something about how it sometimes feels as if they're fading away, but I have a hard time relating on account of...well, knowing literally {i}nothing{/i} about my parents.
lines.zh: 她提到有时候会觉得他们正在慢慢淡去，但我很难有同感——因为……嗯，我对自己的父母真是{i}一无所知{/i}。

lines.en: Either way, it’s surprising how unfazed she seems in the face of that. But I guess that as long as they’re sending her money, everything will be fine.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，她面对这件事时出奇地平静。不过我想，只要他们还给她寄钱，一切就都没问题。

lines.en: Some people cherish that level of independence, especially at her age. And Futaba is no exception.
lines.zh: 有些人很珍视那种程度的独立，尤其是在她这个年纪。Futaba 也不例外。

lines.en: I just hope that this part of her doesn't change any time soon.
lines.zh: 我只希望她这一部分不要很快就改变。

lines.en: Because, despite what I frequently tell her, I have no idea if I'll always be there for her or not.
lines.zh: 因为，尽管我常对她那么说，我也不知道自己是不是能一直在她身边。

lines.en: And being all alone in this world doesn't seem like it would be very fun.
lines.zh: 而孤零零地活在这个世界上，看起来不会是什么有趣的事。

lines.zh: {i}Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]！{/i}
